@name: Guild Member
@slug: guild_member
@source: sohk
@category: RMFRP School of Hard Knocks
@default_cost: 25
@description:
 [Vocational] Guild members are the principle tradesmen in a society that has
 a system of guilds. They make up the primary population of crafters,
 merchants, and artisans, selling their services to whorever can afford them.
 A guild member will often have influential contacts among the various power
 groups of a city, and will know who to talk with to get things done. Time to
 Acquire: 18 months. Starting Money: normal.
